data.simulator: pool lookup: querying a pool sample_id reveals its measured y; nothing else
data.hash_provenance: features and model independently hashed in R8p; target CSV, B.npy and source ZIP hashes inherited from round 7, not opened or verified in R8p; executor verifies before running

label_access.R8p: No target values or target-derived data read from CSV; no source CSV opened. Round-7 reports are disclosed prior knowledge.
label_access.design: features.csv explicit input-column allowlist; optional scalars CSV read only with design_columns usecols; ignore legacy cell/corner columns
label_access.training: Only experiment-local S0 and queried IDs; candidate labels remain unread. No cross-experiment, cross-pair or cross-arm label/model cache.
label_access.calibration: Only after all 180 acquisition trajectories and models b=0..6 are sealed; CAL labels only produce q, never fit or select.
label_access.evaluation: After calibration and predictions are sealed, evaluation process reads declared evaluation IDs; no feedback to any training process. No experiment receives another experiment outputs.

reuse.integration: Future R8 adapter uses isolated deep-copied CONFIG with only gp_random_state overridden per experiment. Do not mutate round-6/7 files or share module state between E1/E2. Do not use evaluation_frame (hardcodes round-6 keys), legacy fixed_sequence (round-6 CONFIG) or naive signflip_p for K=30.
reuse.family_reference_function: family_features (source read only; not imported in R8p)

features.duty: mean(diff_periodic(B) > 0)  (fraction of samples with rising flux)
features.plateau: existing magnet_igse.classify plateau fraction: mean(|diff| < 0.1 * quantile(|diff|, 0.9))
features.shape: log10( mean( (|diff_periodic(B)| * 1024 * f)^1.5 ) / (4 * f * Bpk)^1.5 ), i.e. log10(mean(|dB/dt|^1.5) / (4 f Bpk)^1.5)
features.cell_for_mixed: v=log10(4*frequency_Hz*amplitude_T); lo/hi=min/max over experiment pool including S0; bin=clip(floor(8*(v-lo)/(hi-lo)),0,7); freeze once; require hi>lo
features.f_setpoint: sort unique frequency_Hz; start a new cluster whenever log(f_i/f_{i-1}) > 0.01; setpoint = round(median(cluster)/1000) kHz (20 setpoints expected: 50..446 kHz)
features.family: String f"{fset}_{waveform}_{round(10*duty)}_{round(20*plateau)}"; Python ties-to-even round; lexicographic string sorting; 291 global families, 220 with support rows. Build from full input frame before restriction.
features.temperature_mapping: features.csv T_C equals scalar temperature_C; only 25,50,70,90 allowed

H: int(first 8 hex chars of the prereg commit SHA, 16)

model.name: M2-magnet: OLS linear mean on linear_mean_features + residual GP on standardized gp_inputs + sigma-normalized split conformal
model.scaler: sklearn StandardScaler fit on the arm's current training gp_inputs
model.conformal: Per arm and b: q = sorted(|y-mu|/sigma)[ceil((n+1)*0.9)-1] on its fixed CAL; all rows equal weight. Require finite scores and rank<=n. No distribution-free coverage guarantee for family-dependent or shifted evaluation data.
model.refit: hyperparameters re-optimized at every batch and for the final model
model.note: Model equations/hyperparameters unchanged; optimizer seed renewed per experiment to satisfy fresh-seed requirement. E1 is a new-randomization replication, not an independent dataset.

E1_replication.purpose: Confirm round-7 nominal H4/H5 on same X7 with new family, S0, R and GP seeds; K=30; no claim of independent new labels.
E1_replication.X7: frequency_Hz >= 200000 AND amplitude_T >= 0.10 (632 samples), removed from pool and calibration
E1_replication.ok_families: families with no X7 sample, sorted by key
E1_replication.G_CAL: perm=default_rng(seed(e=1,r=0,k=0)).permutation(sorted(eligible_family_strings)); G7r=all rows in perm[:40]; CAL7r=all rows in perm[40:60]
E1_replication.pool: all minus X7 minus G7r minus CAL7r
E1_replication.dBdt_bins: 8 equal-width bins of log10(4 f Bpk) over E1 pool [min,max]

E2_onesided.purpose: UNSUPPORTED one-sided extrapolation: no data on the far side
E2_onesided.XF: f_setpoint >= 300 kHz (316/355/397/446) AND temperature_C <= 70: frequency extrapolation beyond 282 kHz
E2_onesided.XT: temperature_C == 90 AND f_setpoint < 300 kHz: temperature extrapolation beyond 70 C
E2_onesided.XFT: f_setpoint >= 300 kHz AND temperature_C == 90: double extrapolation (report-only)
E2_onesided.families: round-7 family keys restricted to support samples; support_families = families with >=1 support sample, sorted by key
E2_onesided.G_CAL: perm=default_rng(seed(2,0,0)).permutation(sorted(support_family_strings)); G8=support rows in perm[:30]; CAL8=support rows in perm[30:50]
E2_onesided.pool: support minus G8 minus CAL8; all XF/XT/XFT IDs excluded from training and calibration
E2_onesided.dBdt_bins: 8 equal-width bins of log10(4 f Bpk) over E2 pool [min,max]
E2_onesided.isolation_note: G8/CAL8 hold out entire families within support only. XT may share family keys with support: temperature extrapolation, not unseen-family extrapolation. XF and XFT have no training frequency support.
E2_onesided.geometry_note: 282 kHz is support ceiling, not guaranteed realized training maximum; actual pool/training maxima must be reported. XF v range lies inside full support v range, not necessarily realized pool range.

acquisition.candidates: pool minus S0_k minus points already selected by this arm
acquisition.A: kriging believer on GP posterior std incl. WhiteKernel (as round 3): within a batch, hyperparameters and y normalization fixed, Cholesky augmented with each chosen point; pick argmax sigma; tie -> lowest sample_id
acquisition.M: Same believer; score=sigma/sqrt(1+a_c); a_c counts this arm additions in bin across all batches and earlier choices in current batch, excluding S0; no quota guarantee; ties lowest numeric sample_id
acquisition.batch_protocol: For b=0..5 fit 100+20b observed points from scratch; choose next batch without its labels; then reveal 20 selected labels. Fit final b=6 model on 220 points. No CAL or evaluation labels until both experiments finish all acquisition.

metrics.coverage: count of y in [mu - q sigma, mu + q sigma]
metrics.winkler: mean Winkler score, alpha=0.1, log10 units: (U-L) + (2/alpha)(L-y)[y<L] + (2/alpha)(y-U)[y>U]
metrics.relative_error: median over set of |10^mu - P| / P
metrics.weighting: All rows equal weight within each evaluation set; all K pairs equal weight; final b=6 primary; same sets for all arms

tests.type: Exact one-sided sign-flip, p=#{s in {-1,+1}^30: mean(s*d)>=mean(d)-1e-12}/2**30; identity and ties included; zeros retain multiplicity; integer numerator, no Monte Carlo
tests.gatekeeping: single fixed sequence; stop at first non-rejection; later 'not tested'
tests.computation: Meet-in-the-middle: two lists of 2**15 signed sums; count pairs with sum >= sum(d)-30e-12; O(2**15) storage plus sorting; no 2**30 vector allocation
tests.reject_rule: p < 0.05 AND all preceding hypotheses rejected; p==0.05 is non-rejection
tests.assumption: Conditional on fixed dataset and split, independent paired seed repetitions and sign symmetry at the zero boundary (including shifted H2 differences). For composite mean<=0 null, use symmetric location-shift model. Exact enumeration alone does not ensure assumption-free validity.
tests.inference_scope: Algorithmic variability conditional on this dataset and single family split per experiment; not population/material-wide evidence. Fixed-sequence FWER<=0.05 only when each p is valid under its stated null.
tests.validity_gate: CV/V/HONEST are separate descriptive gates; they do not stop the p sequence or remove pairs. Process failure prevents confirmatory claims.

validity.aggregation: Per method and experiment, not pooled across A/M/R or E1/E2; >=ceil(0.85*30)=26. Descriptive repeatability threshold, not a confidence bound.
validity.E1_arm: C1: coverage(G7r)>=ceil(0.8*nG); C2: coverage(X7)>=506 AND width(X7)<=3*width(G7r)
validity.E1_CV_X: At least 26/30 arms of method X pass C1 AND C2; 80% engineering floor for R7 comparability, not nominal honesty
validity.E2_arm_F: VF: C1 AND coverage(XF)>=4289 AND width(XF)<=3*width(G8)
validity.E2_arm_T: VT: C1 AND coverage(XT)>=6676 AND width(XT)<=3*width(G8)
validity.E2_V_X_region: At least 26/30 arms of method X pass VF or VT for that region
validity.honesty: HONEST90(X,F/T): at least 26/30 arms satisfy that region nominal-90% coverage count. Coverage only; report alongside V80 and widths. Descriptive finite-panel criterion, not a guarantee or hypothesis test; independent of H1-H6 gate.
validity.process: All 180 arms and 30 differences per hypothesis complete and finite; ID isolation, exact budgets, source/model hashes, seeds and batch replay pass; no outcome-based exclusions. Missing/failing arms -> incomplete, no confirmatory claims; retry same seed/state only for logged infrastructure failure.

conclusions.M-NI10-X7: H2 rejected AND E1 CV-M AND E1 CV-A; 10% Winkler noninferiority, not equivalence
conclusions.A-F: H3 rejected AND V-A(F) AND HONEST90(A,F)
conclusions.M-F: H4 rejected AND V-M(F) AND HONEST90(M,F)
conclusions.A-T: H5 rejected AND V-A(T) AND HONEST90(A,T)
conclusions.M-T: H6 rejected AND V-M(T) AND HONEST90(M,T)
conclusions.all: Require process valid. Report raw hypothesis status and each validity gate separately. Failure/non-testing is not evidence of equivalence or inferiority.

report_only: All 30 pair differences per hypothesis; mean, median, IQR, positive/zero/negative counts; all nominal p with gate status; no rounding before tests
Per arm b=0..6 q, MAE, bias, coverage count/fraction, width, Winkler, median RE; only b=6 confirmatory
E2 A/M/R by XF/XT/XFT coverage mean/min/max, nominal90 shortfall max(0,0.9-coverage), width, V80 pass count and HONEST90 pass count (XFT summaries only, no pass/fail conclusion)
Sampling by f_setpoint, T, dBdt_bin; E2 additions at 282 kHz or 70 C; S0 reported separately; realized training and pool frequency/temperature extrema

iGSE median RE after all learning/evaluation sealed: X7,G7r,G8,XF,XT,XFT; prefit temperature-specific parameters may use held-out sines, including 90 C; descriptive, not fair unsupported baseline or statistical claim
Per-method validity pass counts in dedicated field validity_pass_counts; sampling counts in separate sampling_counts; never reuse field as in R7 erratum

execution.R8p_scope: Only these documents/config; no experiment code, fitting, sampling, labels, network, installs, commit or push

watchdog.action: Stop dispatch and pause experiment workers; keep watchdog alive; resume above upper threshold. Pausing does not reclaim memory: persistent low memory/OOM -> logged infrastructure stop and same-seed checkpoint resume, no parameter/sample change.

execution.detached: nohup setsid on local_node; watchdog outside paused worker process groups
execution.review: Executor records push and design manifest before run; seal first evaluation; independent recomputation and reviewer_b review after run; do not overwrite first results. No post-outcome design changes.

authorship.revision: Independent input-only review and rewrite; see docs/discussion/m9/researcher_a_R8p_review.md

freeze.commit_rule: First commit containing this researcher_a revision and this config, pushed before any R8 split generation, sampling, fitting, calibration or evaluation. Record full commit SHA externally; do not substitute HEAD or grind commits for a split.
freeze.H: int(first 8 hex chars of that prereg commit SHA, 16)
freeze.post_commit_manifest: Record prereg/config/implementation hashes, full SHA, H, all seeds, source checks, sorted IDs, families, bins and software versions before label access. No placeholder SHA may be used.

seeds.H: int(first 8 hex chars of the prereg commit SHA, 16)
seeds.rng: numpy.random.default_rng (PCG64); pin NumPy version in manifest
seeds.gp_seed_scope: One fixed uint32 seed per experiment, shared across its paired arms, all k and all batches; GP initialized afresh at each fit.
seeds.nonoverlap: Design seeds exceed 2**64; GP seeds in [2**31, 2**31+2**30-1]; E1/E2 distinct. All differ from round-7 seeds. No modulus on design seeds, no reseeding based on outcomes.
seeds.interpretation: Distinct integer RNG seeds; random draws and sample IDs may overlap across groups or experiments. Deliberate seed sharing inside a matched group is allowed.

power.method: Analytic normal location approximation Phi(delta*sqrt(K)-Phi^-1(0.95)); no simulation/bootstrap in R8p; not exact sign-flip or sequential power
power.limitations: Historical selected nominal H4 may overstate effect; E2 effect unknown; later hypothesis power also requires every prior rejection and conclusion validity. No post-result K increase.
power.cost: 180 arms; 7 fits/arm (b=0..6), 1260 logical fits; historical 60-arm 5.1 min is rough planning only, no runtime guarantee.
